title: Backjump over unused splits in propositional Lean proofs
summary: The Lean reconstructor's propositional prover now drops case splits whose branch does not use its hypothesis (backjumping) and keeps only the proof steps it uses. The QF_IDL circuit ckt_PROP1_tf_10 now verifies in Lean, and BubbleSort, MinMax and parity check several times faster.
